clips.title: The story
paras: You carry Brock Stoneseeker's missive to Ironforge and receive Honorary Picks for the return to Thelsamar. Gryth Thurden can take you across the mountains by gryphon.

Gryth Thurden oversees Ironforge's gryphon flights from the city's central platform. The roosts link the mountain stronghold with settlements such as Loch Modan, carrying messages and trade between them. Before you can fly to Thelsamar, you need to have met its handler, Thorgrum Borrelson. Once that is done, Gryth can send you back with the picks.
Brock Stoneseeker teaches mining in Thelsamar and needs tools for his apprentices. The Honorary Picks you carry will let young miners work the copper and tin veins in the hills around the Loch.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: For a small fee you can buy a gryphon ride to Thelsamar... As long as you've already been there. Gryphons will only fly you to places you've already been, so be sure to speak with every gryphon master you see so you can fly to him later.
You've already been to Thorgrum, the gryphon master of Thelsamar, so now you can return to him. And once in Thelsamar, you can deliver the picks to Brock Stoneseeker.
Speak with me when you're ready to go.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, friend. Have you returned from Ironforge?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You brought the picks. Great! I'll get these to my mining students. I'm sure they're eager to use them on the ore deposits of Loch Modan.
Thank you for your help, friend. I am in your debt, but I hope this money will at least cover your travel costs.
